title: Ship base-red gate tells a test-only defect from a product defect
body: Evidence 2026-11-18: t-8sgwaqg fixed a defect inside test/brain/skill-harvest.test.ts only (shared temp root); krn pr ship exited 81 "passes on the base source: the regression test does not reproduce the defect" (src/ci/base-red.ts:148) because the fixed test runs green on base source by construction; the lead had to reclassify the task as debt to ship (#3db6512).

Outcome: when a defect PR changes only test files, the base-red gate runs the base version of the changed test under the proof environment (or accepts a red-before line from the PR body) instead of the new test on base source, and names that path in the verdict.
Proof: test/ci/ship.test.ts: a defect branch changing only a test file -> the gate runs the base test version; a src change -> unchanged behaviour.
